Graphic Attitudes

Understanding how to shape visual languages to express messages is key to the subject of graphic design.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Analyse visual source material to identify influences, themes, and strategies relevant to the development of creative work

+  Analyse and assess the message and tone of voice to inform the development of conceptual ideas

+  Apply creative approaches to organise and communicate visual content

+  Reflect on the effectiveness of the design for the intended message and audience
